about: CarePlus Multispeciality Clinic provides general medical consultation and basic outpatient healthcare services.

location.address: 123 Main Road, Salem, Tamil Nadu, India

appointment.booking_method: Patients can call the clinic to request an appointment.
appointment.walk_ins: Walk-in consultations are accepted subject to doctor availability.

policies.appointment_cancellation: Patients are requested to inform the clinic in advance if they need to cancel or reschedule.
policies.emergency: For medical emergencies, contact local emergency medical services or visit the nearest emergency department.
